statement: For every fixed coarse class sigma and every k>=1, every induced P_k in Q_sigma lifts to an induced P_k in G by choosing one arbitrary representative from each component-node.

proof.map: survivor node v maps to v; component node [C] maps to arbitrary c_C in C
consecutive_pairs: survivor-survivor consecutive adjacency is preserved because Q_sigma[S_sigma]=G[S_sigma] exactly
survivor-component consecutive adjacency means v complete to C, so v-c_C is an edge
nonconsecutive_pairs: survivor-survivor nonadjacency is preserved exactly from G[S_sigma]
survivor-component nonadjacency in Q_sigma means v is not complete to C; B0 says complete or anticomplete, hence v is anticomplete to C and v-c_C is a nonedge
distinct component nodes represent distinct connected components of G[Y0], so chosen representatives are nonadjacent
proof.exhaustion: These cases exhaust every pair on the lifted sequence, hence exactly the consecutive pairs are edges.
proof.conclusion: The image is an induced P_k in G.

corollary: Ambient P7-freeness of G implies Q_sigma is P7-free.
